text: Designed and built LLM-powered AI agents (the agentic fixing tool) that let non-engineering teams autonomously fix product data, covering tool interface design, prompt engineering, and self-correction loops for production reliability, eliminating engineering tickets and delivering an estimated $1M in annual financial impact.

Automated product data enrichment by building and maintaining end-to-end MLOps pipelines on Python and Airflow, spanning data preprocessing, LLM-based labeling, model training, evaluation, and serving, to improve catalog accuracy across Klarna's shopping experience.

Own LLMOps observability and reliability for production ML serving on Kubernetes, monitored via Argo and Datadog, including a postprocessing pipeline refactor that cut production API response time by ~80% (p50: 33ms -> 6ms).

Designed and maintained production-grade ETL pipelines in Python and SQL Redshift, orchestrated with Airflow and validated through pytest-based unit and integration tests, delivering trusted, analytics-ready datasets for regulatory reporting and cross-market business expansion while adhering to GDPR regulations, supporting Klarna’s market launches and banking license requirements.

Co-designed a standardized, modular data processing platform across pipelines, leveraging Apache Flink (streaming) and Spark (batch) based on processing needs, with Spock-driven test coverage across shared components. Reduced infrastructure setup time and team alignment overhead by 75%, improved service consistency and governance, and enabled engineers to focus on business logic rather than foundational components.
Modeled schemas and data semantics in AWS Glue Data Catalog to standardize reporting logic and ensure consistent metric definitions across markets.

Developed data-processing applications with Apache Spark and AWS Glue integrating diverse data sources — including Kafka for streaming events and GraphQL APIs for on-demand data retrieval — with the goal of enhancing customer credit history management through automated reporting, reducing relative unpaid delinquency rates by 20% and increasing more than 10% of purchasing active users in a month.

Designed and built a Flask REST API to automate secure file transfers between processing and submission services, deployed as a Dockerized solution on EC2 to meet a client's stringent financial regulatory requirements, reducing operational workload by 6 hours per week and eliminating manual errors through improved automation and logging.

Reduced incident response time by implementing data validation and end-to-end monitoring, integrating AWS CloudWatch metrics with Datadog dashboards and Slack notifications for real-time visibility across automated workflows.

Partnered with internal data consumers as the go-to domain expert on a dedicated Slack channel, clarifying metric definitions, data lineage, and business logic behind debt reporting datasets so stakeholders could trust the data they relied on.

Translated business and risk requirements into scalable data transformations, enabling expansion into three new markets and supporting 133% average volume increase (EUR 74.05M), and powering phishing detection automation with a 5,000% increase in URL reviews per year.
Collaborated with engineering and analytics stakeholders to improve transaction acceptance and fraud detection metrics through data-driven experimentation and model integration.
Automated credit bureau reporting by designing and maintaining Redshift-based transformation workflows orchestrated with Airflow, reducing lookup costs by up to 20%.
Led the migration of a centralized lookup and caching service, preventing cost duplication, improving data consistency, and reducing timeouts by 11%.

Own the CI/CD pipeline migration effort as the go-to person for Jenkins: scoped the migration, laid the groundwork, and drove exploration, while coordinating implementation support given the team's existing volume of build jobs.

Co-designed a governed, canonical data model turning a dozen scattered raw event streams (orders, balances, payment obligations) into one consistent, queryable representation for downstream services, with the loan grain as a key modeled entity.

Defined an explicit schema versioning strategy for a multi-consumer data contract: additive, nullable changes evolve in place, while breaking changes get a new versioned table with dual-write and a defined consumer migration plan. Schema changes are code-defined (Avro), generating an ordered migration checked into Git and peer-reviewed via pull request.

Built a monthly batch reporting pipeline ingesting Kafka streams stored in Iceberg format in S3; built a Glue/Spark job producing a common table used across multiple reports, plus a client-specific Glue job outputting the exact data points required, followed by a formatting and submission service.

Contributed to a machine learning initiative aimed at user identification, resulting in a 6% increase in identified customers. Supported migration between financial risk platforms by implementing business logic, writing unit tests, and validating node changes through deployment stages.

Streamlined data workflows and reporting by automating processes in Looker, Excel, and VBA, reducing team workload by 5 hours weekly while improving invoicing accuracy. Designed real-time dashboards and scheduled reports for stakeholders.

Built a near real-time analytics data pipeline streaming Postgres changes through Debezium (CDC), Kafka, and Spark into a FastAPI serving layer, built from a blank repo without relying on any company tooling.
